text:
mira: Proposal: retire the precision-compat shim (fp8->int8 fallback layer) after a 6-week grace period. goal is to simplify runtime and avoid maintenance debt.

alex: quick Q — which customers/pinned endpoints are still using the shim? can we enumerate?

mira: good call. ops query I ran shows ~7 endpoints in prod across 3 customers (two private, one dedicated). most traffic is low-volume.

jamal: ops-wise we need a safe canary. suggest flag flow: `precision_shim.enabled` default true -> staged canary false for 5% -> 0% -> remove.

sasha: agree on canary. also want calibration snapshots before each step. we should capture quality deltas on top-3 prompts per endpoint.

devon: how do we detect regressions automatically? we don't want noisy alerts. propose: collect per-request top-k LM score + hallucination metric, run regression if aggregated BLEU/qa-f1 drops > 2% and p-value < 0.01.

mira: +1. will draft an eval harness. jamal can you add a telemetry query that spits out weekly deltas for the canary group?

jamal: yep. I'll add a grafana panel and a scheduled job that posts to #eng-ml-canaries. query will include `degradation_score`, `avg_latency`, `token_cost` and `percent_lowbit_fallbacks`.

ops-bot: scheduled maintenance window created: 2025-07-03 02:00 UTC -> 2025-07-03 06:00 UTC. notifies affected customers when we flip flags.

mira: timeline idea: week 0 — announce to customers + docs; week 1 — baseline snapshots; week 2 — 5% canary; week 4 — 0% (shim off for prod); week 6 — remove shim code. thoughts?

alex: add a rollback gate at every step. if `degradation_score` > threshold or customer reports > 3 incidents in 24h -> immediate rollback of the flag.

sasha: also lock autoupgrades for pinned model versions during the canary. we don't want model compaction to confound results.

devon: small snippet for the feature flag toggle in ops playbook:
```
# toggle shim for canary segment
redis.hset("feature:precision_shim", "group:canary", "false")
# sanity check
curl -sS https://infra-api/flags/precision_shim | jq
```

mira: nice. who owns communications? I can draft the customer-facing note and the internal RFC update. jamal handle infra runbook? sasha QA?

jamal: I'll own infra runbook + dashboards. will coordinate with infra-bot for rollout automation.

sasha: QA will run regression tests against the customer prompt sets and a randomized subset of internal workloads. I'll post a checklist in this thread when ready.

infra-bot: noted: runbook task created (#RB-4127) assigned to jamal. rollback playbook template attached.

mira: last items — add a telemetry tag `shim_retire_phase` to all requests during the experiment, and include `model_quant_profile` in logs. gives us traceability.

devon: +1. also add a lightweight spam filter to the alerting so we don't escalate on tiny statistically insignificant blips.

mira: thanks all. I'll push the announcement draft by EOD and link the canary dashboard. planning sync on Monday 10am PT. :calendar:
